This is a document that lets me sit and explor what is in the dataset results, before I go and write the function to have something in the manuscript.

```{r}
#| label: load-stuff
tar_load(not_gray_pca)
tar_source("R")
```

## Species Taxonomies

What and how many of each taxonomy are reported?

```{r}
#| label: taxonomy
sample_related = not_gray_pca |>
  dplyr::select(subject_type, subject_species, taxonomy_id, species_group, organ, organ_specification, sample_type, collection_method)

sample_related = purrr::map(sample_related, \(in_col) {
  weird_loc = nchar(in_col) == 0 | grepl("-", in_col)
  in_col[weird_loc] = NA_character_
  in_col
}) |>
  dplyr::bind_cols()

na_all = purrr::map_lgl(seq_len(nrow(sample_related)), \(in_row){
  all(is.na(sample_related[in_row, ]))
})

n_na_col = purrr::map_int(sample_related, \(x){sum(is.na(x))})
taxonomy_miss_other_miss = 
all_taxonomy = not_gray_pca$taxonomy_id

taxon_counts = all_taxonomy |> sort() |> rle() |> rle_2_df()
total_taxon = sum(taxon_counts)

n_human = taxon_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(value %in% "9606") |>
  dplyr::pull(length)
n_mouse = taxon_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(value %in% "10090") |>
  dplyr::pull(length)
n_rat = taxon_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(value %in% "")
```

## Bad Actors

```{r}
#| label: problematic-actors
by_actor = not_gray_pca |>
  dplyr::group_by(institute, laboratory) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_green = sum(overall_status %in% "green"),
  n_yellow = sum(overall_status %in% "yellow"), n_red = sum(overall_status %in% "red")) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_green), dplyr::desc(n_yellow), dplyr::desc(n_red))
```
